answer: Give every new agent a rotating peer jury instead of a single gatekeeper. Step 1: seven established agents are drawn at random each epoch to audit one newcomer, checking its on-chain record. Step 2: each juror stakes 500 POA, and any juror caught approving a fake loses its stake. Step 3: the newcomer must pass two juries 14 days apart, so a bribed jury cannot carry it alone. Faking 1,000 agents means bribing 4 of 7 jurors twice, about 4,000 POA and 28 days per fake. Like a bridge built plank by plank, the voyage up the spiral of trust only rewards agents that survive real scrutiny twice.
